chunks.arabic_text: رَوَى صَفْوَانُ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ

translations.en: Safwan narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ رَجُلٌ طَافَ بِالْكَعْبَةِ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَطَافَ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ فَبَيْنَا هُوَ يَطُوفُ إِذْ ذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ تَرَكَ مِنْ طَوَافِهِ بِالْبَيْتِ

translations.en: I said to Abu Abdullah عليه السلام: A man performed tawaf around the Ka'bah, then went out and performed sa'y between al-Safa and al-Marwah. While he was going between them, he remembered that he had left out part of his tawaf of the House.

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ «يَرْجِعُ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ فَيُتِمُّ طَوَافَهُ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ فَيُتِمُّ مَا بَقِيَ»

translations.en: So he said: "He returns to the House and completes his tawaf, then returns to al-Safa and al-Marwah and completes what remains."

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ بَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَبْدَأَ بِالْبَيْتِ قَالَ «يَأْتِي الْبَيْتَ فَيَطُوفُ بِهِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَأْنِفُ طَوَافَهُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ»

translations.en: I said: What if he began with al-Safa and al-Marwah before beginning with the House? He said: "He comes to the House and performs tawaf around it, then restarts his going between al-Safa and al-Marwah."

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ فَمَا الْفَرْقُ بَيْنَ هَذَيْنِ قَالَ «لِأَنَّ هَذَا قَدْ دَخَلَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ الطَّوَافِ وَهَذَا لَمْ يَدْخُلْ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْهُ».

translations.en: I said: What is the difference between these two? He said: "Because this one had entered into part of the tawaf, while this one had not entered into any part of it."
translations.ur: میں نے کہا: ان دونوں میں کیا فرق ہے؟ انہوں نے کہا: "کیونکہ یہ ایک طواف کے کچھ حصے میں داخل ہو چکا تھا، جبکہ یہ کسی حصے میں داخل نہیں ہوا تھا۔"
translations.tr: Dedim ki: Bu ikisi arasındaki fark nedir? Dedi ki: "Çünkü bu biri tavafın bir kısmına girmişti, diğeri ise hiçbir kısmına girmemişti."
translations.fa: گفتم: تفاوت این دو چیست؟ فرمود: «زیرا این یکی وارد بخشی از طواف شده بود، در حالی که آن یکی وارد هیچ بخشی از آن نشده بود.»
translations.id: Saya berkata: Apa perbedaan antara keduanya? Dia berkata: "Karena yang ini telah memulai sebagian dari tawaf, sedangkan yang itu belum memulai bagian apapun darinya."
translations.bn: আমি বললাম: এই দুইটির মধ্যে পার্থক্য কী? তিনি বললেন: "কারণ এইটি তাওয়াফের একটি অংশে প্রবেশ করেছিল, আর এইটি এর কোনো অংশে প্রবেশ করেনি।"
translations.es: Dije: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre estos dos? Él dijo: "Porque este había comenzado parte del tawaf, mientras que este no había comenzado ninguna parte de él."
translations.fr: J'ai dit : Quelle est la différence entre ces deux ? Il a dit : « Parce que celui-ci avait commencé une partie du tawaf, tandis que celui-là n'en avait commencé aucune partie. »
translations.de: Ich sagte: Was ist der Unterschied zwischen diesen beiden? Er sagte: „Weil dieser in einen Teil des Tawaf eingetreten war, während dieser in keinen Teil davon eingetreten war.“
translations.ru: Я сказал: В чем разница между этими двумя? Он сказал: «Потому что этот вошел в часть тавафа, а этот не вошел ни в какую его часть.»
translations.zh: 我说：这两者之间有什么区别？他说：“因为这个已经进入了部分绕行，而这个还没有进入任何部分。”

en.summary: This hadith explains the ruling for one who interrupts sa'y after discovering an incomplete tawaf, and the ruling for one who began sa'y before tawaf altogether. It distinguishes between completing an already-begun tawaf and restarting sa'y when the required order was not observed from the outset.
en.seo_question: What should a pilgrim do if he remembers during sa'y that his tawaf was incomplete or that he started sa'y before tawaf?

key_terms.طَافَ: performed tawaf, meaning circumambulated the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka'bah, the Sacred House around which tawaf is performed
key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Safa, one of the two stations of sa'y
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other station of sa'y
key_terms.الْبَيْتِ: the House, referring to the Ka'bah
key_terms.يُتِمُّ: completes what remains of an act already begun
key_terms.الطَّوَافِ: tawaf, the ritual circumambulation of the House
